y-m-79-04.title: Vanoti kutengesa kweshopu yeshaved-ice kwakakura 30% mumwedzi
y-m-79-04.topic: Seasonality mudata renguva nekuenzanisa gore negore
y-m-79-04.goal: Ziva kuti nei mwero wekukura wemwedzi mumwe woga uchiita kuti zvive zvakaoma kutonga kukura, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako uchishandisa kuenzanisa nemwedzi wakafanana wegore rapfuura neruzivo rwekuwedzera (nhamba yezvigaro).
y-m-79-04.material: Kutengesa kweshopu yeshaved-ice muna Chikumi uno kwaiva 120만 원, uye kutengesa kwaChikunguru kwaiva 156만 원. Muridzi akati, "Kutengesa kwakakura kusvika 30% mumwedzi, saka shopu yedu iri kukura nekukurumidza zvakajeka!" (Yuniti: 만 원. Fungidzira kuti mwedzi yose miviri ine mazuva ebhizinesi akafanana.)
y-m-79-04.thinking.1: Kusarudza iwe amene base yekuenzanisa (mwedzi wakapfuura kana mwedzi wakafanana wegore rapfuura) nekuverenga
y-m-79-04.prereq.0: Basa iri rakaiswa pakuoma kwe H3 (nhanho yakaoma), richifungidzira vadzidzi vari kutora kosi yekusarudza yechikoro chepamusoro 'Practical Statistics', uye hariratidzi kuti Ministry of Education inopa zvirimo izvi kugiredhi rakati. Zvinodiwa kutanga: kuverenga mwero wekukura (maperesenti) nekuverenga matebhura. Mubasa iri, izwi re seasonal variation rinotsanangurwa senge 'mhedzisiro yemwaka inodzokororwa gore rega rega'.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.prompt: Nhamba dziri pamusoro (Chikumi uno 120만 원, Chikunguru 156만 원) dzakakwana kutaura kuti 'shopu yakura' here?
y-m-79-04.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira kuti kutengesa kweshopu yeshaved-ice kunokwira nekudzika riini muhuwandu hwegore, uye ufungidzire kana shanduko kubva muna Chikumi kuenda kuna Chikunguru ingangoitika gore rega rega.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora nhamba mbiri dzaunofanira kuenzanisa kusimbisa kuti 'yakura' mushure mekubvisa mhedzisiro yemwaka.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.o.a: Zvakakwana. Kana kutengesa kwakakura kusvika 30% mumwedzi, kukura kukuru zvakajeka.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.r.a: Wakaverenga kuwedzera kukuru mumwedzi mumwe sekukura. Kushopu inokanganiswa nemwaka sashaved ice, kuwedzera kunogona kuva kunodzokororwa gore rega rega.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.o.b: Hazvina kukwana. Tinoda kutengesa kwaNyamavhuvhu futi kuti titonge.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.r.b: Pasina kumirira kusvika Nyamavhuvhu, unogona kuchinja base yekuenzanisa mukati medata ratowanikwa.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.o.c: Hazvina kukwana. Tinoda futi kutengesa kwegore rapfuura kwemwedzi wakafanana.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.r.c: Iyi ipfungwa yekusefa mhedzisiro yemwaka nekuenzanisa mwedzi yakafanana.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.o.d: Hazvina kukwana. Tinoda futi kugoverwa kwekutengesa kweshopu dzimwe gore rino.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.r.d: Kuenzanisa neshopu dziri padhuze ipfungwa inobatsirawo, asi haibatsiri zvakananga pakuparadzanisa kana kuwedzera kweshopu iyi kuri nokuda kwemwaka.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.explain: Kuwedzera kubva muna Chikumi kuenda kuna Chikunguru kunogona kuva nokuda kwemwaka wepamusoro wezhizha. Kuparadzanisa kukura nemhedzisiro yemwaka, unoda data re 'nguva imwe chete', sema Chikumi naChikunguru egore rapfuura.
y-m-79-04.s.s1.acc.0: Kuenzanisa neshopu dzimwe ruzivo runobatsirawo. Zvisinei, kuparadzanisa mhedzisiro yemwaka yeshopu iyi, data regore rapfuura remwedzi wakafanana rakananga zvakanyanya.
y-m-79-04.s.s2.prompt: Data regore rapfuura rasvika. Kutengesa kwaChikumi kwegore rapfuura kwaiva 100만 원 uye kwaChikunguru kwaiva 140만 원. Nyora kuti ungaenzanisa uye uverenge sei kana 'shopu yakura' nedata iri, uye unyore zvaungaudza muridzi semugumisiro.
y-m-79-04.s.s2.hint.0: Batanidza kutengesa kwaChikumi nekwaChikunguru kwegore rapfuura negore rino, uye uzvinyore mutebhura.
y-m-79-04.s.s2.hint.1: Wana huwandu hwekuwedzera pakati pemwedzi yakafanana, uye uuenzanise padivi nemwero wekukura kubva muna Chikumi kuenda kuna Chikunguru.
y-m-79-04.s.s2.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kana ukaenzanisa nemwedzi wakafanana wegore rapfuura...
y-m-79-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakaenzanisa mwedzi yakafanana (Chikumi neChikumi, Chikunguru neChikunguru) here?
y-m-79-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakanongedza here kuti mwero wekukura kubva muna Chikumi kuenda kuna Chikunguru wakafananawo gore rapfuura?
y-m-79-04.s.s2.model.0: Enzanisa nemwedzi wakafanana wegore rapfuura. Chikumi chakakura kubva ku100만 원 kuenda ku120만 원, 20% kumusoro, uye Chikunguru chakakura kubva ku140만 원 kuenda ku156만 원, inenge 11% kumusoro. Gore rino riri pamusoro pegore rapfuura futi, asi mwero wekukura wakadzika, uye kuwedzera kwe30% kubva muna Chikumi kuenda kuna Chikunguru kwaiva 40% gore rapfuura futi, saka mhedzisiro yezhizha ihuru.
y-m-79-04.s.s2.model.1: Kuenzanisa nemwedzi wakapfuura kunosanganisa mhedzisiro yemwaka, saka ndakaenzanisa mwero wekukura kubva muna Chikumi kuenda kuna Chikunguru wegore rapfuura (40%) nemwero wekukura wegore rino (30%). Mwero wekukura wegore rino wakaderera. Kutengesa kuri pamusoro pemwedzi yakafanana yegore rapfuura, saka ndinogona kuudza muridzi kuti shopu yakura, asi kumhanya kwakaderera.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.prompt: Ruzivo rwakadzidzwa nyowani: shopu iyi yakawedzera nhamba yezvigaro zvayo ne20% kupfuura gore rapfuura pakupera kwaChivabvu gore rino. Uchiratidza ruzivo urwu futi, dudziro ipi inokodzera zvikuru yeshanduko ye 'kutengesa pachigaro chimwe' kana ichienzaniswa negore rapfuura? (Kutengesa pachigaro chimwe = kutengesa ÷ nhamba yezvigaro)
y-m-79-04.s.s3.hint.0: Govanisa kutengesa kwaChikumi naChikunguru kwegore rino ne1.2 imwe neimwe, uye uvashandure kuita makosha enhamba yezvigaro yakafanana negore rapfuura.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.hint.1: Isa makosha akashandurwa padivi nekutengesa kwemwedzi yakafanana kwegore rapfuura uye uenzanise kana akaenzana, makuru, kana madiki.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.o.a: Muna Chikumi, kutengesa pachigaro chimwe kwakafanana negore rapfuura, uye muna Chikunguru kwakadzika inenge 7%.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.r.a: Wakatarisa mwero wekukura wezvigaro pamwe chete nemwero wekukura wekutengesa. Chikumi i120 ÷ 1.2 = 100, yakafanana negore rapfuura, uye Chikunguru i156 ÷ 1.2 = 130, shoma kupfuura 140 yegore rapfuura.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.o.b: Kutengesa pachigaro chimwe kwakawedzera kubva gore rapfuura muna Chikumi naChikunguru zvose.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.r.b: Kutengesa kwaChikumi kwakakura 20% uye zvigaro zvakakurawo 20%. Kana ukaenzanisa maratio maviri ekukura, zvakaoma kutaura kuti kutengesa pachigaro chimwe kwakakura.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.o.c: Nhamba yezvigaro haina mhedzisiro pakutengesa, saka dudziro yekutanga inoramba sezvayakaita.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.r.c: Kana zvigaro zvikawedzera, vatengi vaunogona kushandira panguva imwe chete vanowedzerawo. Zvakaoma kuti nhamba yezvigaro haina hukama nekutengesa.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.o.d: MunaChikunguru, kutengesa pachigaro chimwe kwakakura inenge 11%, saka kwakakura kupfuura Chikumi.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.r.d: Wakanyanganisa mwero wekukura wekutengesa we11% semwero wekukura wekutengesa pachigaro chimwe. Govanisa nechokwadi chekuti zvigaro zvakakura 20%.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.explain: Zvigaro zvakava 1.2 nguva zvakawanda, saka kana ukagovanisa kutengesa kwegore rino ne1.2 kuenzanisa nhamba yezvigaro nebase yegore rapfuura, Chikumi i120 ÷ 1.2 = 100 (yakafanana ne100 yegore rapfuura), uye Chikunguru i156 ÷ 1.2 = 130 (inenge 7.1% shoma kupfuura 140 yegore rapfuura). Kunyange kutengesa kwakakura, kutengesa pachigaro chimwe kwakaramba kwakafanana kana kwakadzika. Kana kuwedzera kwezvigaro kwaiva chikonzero chekuwedzera kwekutengesa, zvinoreva 'kukura' zvinochinja.

y-m-79-03.title: Chigadzirwa chakadaidzwa kuti chakaipa nemichina yekuongorora ye '95% yakarurama'
y-m-79-03.goal: Simbisa nenhamba kuti kana mhedzisiro yetest ichiti 'yakaipa', chikamu chakaipa chaizvo chinosiyana zvakanyanya nemwero wezvakaipa (base rate) nemwero wekutonga zvisizvo, uye wana iwe pachako zviitiko zvakati wandei zvinogutsa mamiriro.
y-m-79-03.material:
Zvinotevera zvinozivikanwa nezve michina yekuongorora yemuchina wefekitari.
- Zvinhu zvakaipa i 1% yezvigadzirwa zvese.
- Chikamu chezvinhu zvakaipa zvinotongwa kuti zvakaipa i 95%.
- Chikamu chezvinhu zvakajairika zvinotongwa zvisizvo kuti zvakaipa i 5%.

Mushambadzo wemuchina unoti 'Kururama 95%'. Mudzidzi mumwe akati, "Mukana wekuti chigadzirwa chakadaidzwa kuti chakaipa nemuchina chakaipa chaizvo i 95%," uye akaishanda seizvi achishandisa zvigadzirwa 10000.
y-m-79-03.thinking.2: Kutaura ruzivo rwuri kushaikwa mumutsara wemushambadzo
y-m-79-03.prereq.0: Basa iri rakaiswa padanho rekunetsa H3 (danho rakaoma), richifungidzira vadzidzi vari kutora elective ye high school 'Practical Statistics', uye hazvireve kuti Ministry of Education inopa zvirimo izvi kugiredhi rakati. Zvinodiwa: kuverenga ma percentages nema ratios, nemaitiro ekuita yese 10000 nekuverenga 'mangani'. (Haufaniri kushandisa mafomula e probability.) Kana wakatodzidza conditional probability, unogona kutarisa mutengo mumwechete nefomula.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga mumhinduro yemudzidzi uri wakaipa.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.hint.0: Wanza nhamba dziri mumutsetse wega wega zvakare iwe pachako uye utarise kuti dzakarurama.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.hint.1: Mu ratio yemutsetse wekupedzisira, enzanisa 'ratio ye chii pa chii', uye kana nhamba yaunopatsanura nayo i boka rimwechete ne 'zvigadzirwa zvakadaidzwa kuti zvakaipa' zvemubvunzo.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.line.0: Kana zvigadzirwa 10000 zvakaongororwa, pane zvikanganiso 100 nezvigadzirwa zvakajairika 9900.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.line.1: Pazvinhu zvine kukanganisa 100, 95% (zvinhu 95) zvinotongwa sezvine kukanganisa.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.line.3: Saka zvigadzirwa zvinotongwa sezvine kukanganisa i95 + 495 = 590.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.line.4: Pazvo, zvinhu zvine kukanganisa chaizvo i95, saka mugove wekutonga kune kukanganisa kuri kukanganisa chaizvo i95 ÷ 100 = 95%.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.explain: Mitsara 1 kusvika 4 yakarurama. Mumutsara 5, 95 yakarurama, asi nhamba yaunogovanisa nayo inofanira kuva 590, 'zvigadzirwa zvose zvinotongwa sezvine kukanganisa'. 100 inhamba yezvinhu zvine kukanganisa chaizvo, saka haienderani nemubvunzo. 95 ÷ 590 ≈ 0.161, ndiko kuti, inenge 16.1%.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.prompt: Fungidzira muchina wekuongorora une mwero wekukanganisa we p%, umo mugove wezvinhu zvakajairika zvinotongwa zvisirizvo sezvine kukanganisa i q%. (Mugove wezvinhu zvine kukanganisa zvinotongwa sezvine kukanganisa unoramba pa95%.) Fungidzira kuti pane zvigadzirwa zvakawanda, uye gadzira (p, q) 3 dzakasiyana umo hafu (50%) kana kupfuura yezvigadzirwa zvinotongwa sezvine kukanganisa ine kukanganisa chaizvo. p ne q maintegers kubva pa1 kusvika pa10.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza p imwe ne q, uye uwane, pazvigadzirwa 10000, nhamba ye 'zvinotongwa sezvine kukanganisa zvine kukanganisa chaizvo' nenhamba ye 'zvakajairika asi zvinotongwa sezvine kukanganisa'.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa nhamba mbiri idzi, sarudza kuti ipi inofanira kuva huru kuti ive hafu kana kupfuura, wobva wachinja p kana q imwe panguva.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.ok.c1: p ne q zvinobva pa1 kusvika pa10.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.fail.c1: p ne q zvinofanira kuva pakati pe1 ne10.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Ndapota isa p ne q semaintegers.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Pakati petongero dzekukanganisa, 50% kana kupfuura ine kukanganisa chaizvo.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Pakati pezvigadzirwa zvinotongwa sezvine kukanganisa, zvine kukanganisa chaizvo zviri pasi pehafu. Tora zvigadzirwa 10000 uye uenzanise nhamba yetongero dzine kukanganisa chaizvo nenhamba yezvinhu zvakajairika zvakatongwa zvisirizvo.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.explain: Pazvigadzirwa 10000, tongero dzine kukanganisa chaizvo dzinoita 95 × p, uye zvinhu zvakajairika zvakatongwa zvisirizvo zvinoita q × (100 − p). Kana chekutanga chiri chakakura kana chakaenzana nechechipiri, hafu kana kupfuura yetongero dzekukanganisa ine kukanganisa chaizvo. (2, 1) i190 zvichienzaniswa ne98, (5, 5) i475 zvichienzaniswa ne475 (hafu chaizvo), uye (10, 3) i950 zvichienzaniswa ne270. (1, 1) i95 zvichienzaniswa ne99, saka haisi hafu.
y-m-79-03.s.s3.prompt: Kumutengi anoona chete chiziviso che 'Accuracy 95%' uye anotenda kuti 'kana ichiti ine kukanganisa, 95% ine kukanganisa chaizvo', tsanangura zvisingagoni kuzivikanwa kubva panhamba iyi oga, uye unyore ruzivo rupi rumwe rwaanofanira kubvunza.
y-m-79-03.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora kuti zvikamu zviviri zvinogadzira 590 mukushanda kuri pamusoro zvaiva zvii.
y-m-79-03.s.s3.hint.1: Wana kuti nhamba mbiri dzipi dzaifanira kuchinja kuti hukuru hwezvikamu izvozvo zviviri huchinje.
y-m-79-03.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Zvinhu zvine kukanganisa i... yehuwandu hwose
y-m-79-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakasiyanisa kuti 95% iratio yechii here (mugove wekukanganisa kunobatwa, kana mugove wetongero dzakarurama)?
y-m-79-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura nenhamba kuti nei, kana mwero wekukanganisa uri wakaderera, pane zvinhu zvakajairika zvakawanda zvinobatwa zvisirizvo?
y-m-79-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora zvakananga kuti ruzivo rupi rumwe runodiwa here?
y-m-79-03.s.s3.model.0: Zvinhu zvine kukanganisa i1% yehuwandu hwose chete, saka zvinhu zvakajairika zvakawanda zvikuru, uye kunyange kana 5% chete yezvinhu zvakajairika ikabatwa zvisirizvo, iyo i495, yakawanda kupfuura 95 ine kukanganisa chaizvo. Saka kunyange kana ichiti ine kukanganisa, mugove une kukanganisa chaizvo unenge 16%. Unofanira kubvunza zvose mwero wekukanganisa nemwero umo zvinhu zvakajairika zvinotongwa zvisirizvo.
y-m-79-03.s.s3.model.1: Unofanira kuziva kana 95% iri mugove wekukanganisa kunobatwa kana mugove wetongero dzakarurama, uye unofanirawo kuziva mugove unotorwa nezvinhu zvine kukanganisa muhuwandu hwose. Kana mwero umo zvinhu zvakajairika zvinotongwa zvisirizvo sezvine kukanganisa uri mukuru, pangava nezvinhu zvakajairika zvakawanda pakati pezvakabatwa.

y-m-79-01.title: Zvinogona Kutaurwa neFive-Number Summary
y-m-79-01.goal: Kubva pa five-number summary (minimum, ma quartiles, median, maximum), paradzanisa zvinogona nezvisingagone kutaurwa nechokwadi, uye ugadzire iwe pachako ma data sets akasiyana ane summary imwechete kuratidza miganhu ye summary.
y-m-79-01.material:
Mudzidzisi akapa mhedzisiro yeongororo yebasa (0 kusvika ku 50 mapoinzi, mamakisi ese ma integers) yakatorwa nevadzidzi 7 mukirasi imwe se 'five-number summary' chete.

Minimum mapoinzi 10, first quartile mapoinzi 15, median mapoinzi 20, third quartile mapoinzi 30, maximum mapoinzi 50.

Chibvumirano: kana mamakisi evadzidzi 7 akarongwa kubva kudiki kusvika kukuru i x1, x2, ..., x7 (x-one kusvika x-seven), minimum i x1, first quartile i x2, median i x4, third quartile i x6, uye maximum i x7. Vadzidzi vakati wandei vanogona kuva nemakisi akafanana.
y-m-79-01.thinking.1: Kugadzira ma data sets akasiyana ane summary imwechete (counterexamples)
y-m-79-01.thinking.2: Kutaura miganhu yekuenzanisa nema box plots
y-m-79-01.prereq.0: Basa iri rakaiswa padanho rekunetsa H3 (danho rakaoma), richifungidzira vadzidzi vari kutora elective ye high school 'Practical Statistics', uye hazvireve kuti Ministry of Education inopa zvirimo izvi kugiredhi rakati. Zvinodiwa: kurongedza data kubva kudiki kusvika kukuru nekuwana median nema quartiles, nezvinoreva mean. Mubasa iri, zvakabvumirwa kuti ma quartiles e data values 7 i 'mitengo ye2, ye4, ne ye6 kubva kudiki' (maitiro ekusarudza ma quartiles anogona kusiyana zvishoma kubva kubhuku nebhuku).
y-m-79-01.s.s1.prompt: Uchiziva summary iyi chete, sarudza zvese zvinogona kutaurwa kuti zvechokwadi.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.hint.0: Dhirowa mabhokisi 7 e x1 kusvika ku x7, uye tanga wanyora mamakisi emabhokisi anotaurwa ne summary.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.hint.1: Wana kuti bhokisi ripi mudzidzi wesarudzo imwe neimwe anorehwa, uye utarise kana makisi ebhokisi iroro rakasimbiswa kana risina chinhu.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.o.a: Avhareji yemamakisi evadzidzi mukirasi iyi i mapoinzi 20.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.r.a: Mean haisi mu summary. Median ne mean i mitengo yakasiyana, uye kuverenga mutengo wepakati se mean kunofungidzira kuti mamakisi ese mukirasi iyi ari padyo ne 20.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.o.b: Mudzidzi we4 kubva kudiki ane mapoinzi 20.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.r.b: Mukuenderana uku median i mutengo we4. Wakaverenga chaizvo nzvimbo inotaurwa ne summary.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.o.c: Vadzidzi vaviri chaizvo vane mapoinzi 30 kana kupfuura.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.r.c: Kunyange kana x6 i mapoinzi 30, hazvisimbise kuti x5 i shoma kupfuura 30. Mudzidzi we5 anogonawo kuva nemapoinzi 30, saka haugone kutaura 'chaizvo'.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.o.d: Vadzidzi 4 zvishoma vane mapoinzi 20 kana kupfuura.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.r.d: Kana x4 i mapoinzi 20, saka x5, x6, ne x7 hazvigone kuva zvidiki kupfuura x4. Wakashandisa kurongeka kuwana 'zvishoma'.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.r.e: x3 kana x5 inogonawo kuva mapoinzi 20. Kana ukafunga kuti mutengo une summary unoonekwa kamwe chete, unosiya mukana wekuti pane vadzidzi vakawanda vane makisi akafanana.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.explain: Pane vadzidzi 7, saka we4 kubva kudiki i median, mapoinzi 20, uye vadzidzi ve4 kusvika ve7 vese vane mapoinzi 20 kana kupfuura, saka 'zvishoma 4' i chokwadi. Kune rimwe divi, kune x3 tinoziva chete kuti i 15 kana kupfuura uye 20 kana kushoma, uye kune x5 20 kana kupfuura uye 30 kana kushoma, uye hatizivi mitengo chaiyo. Saka mean, 'vangani chaizvo vane 30 kana kupfuura', ne 'vangani chaizvo vane 20' hazvisimbiswi ne summary iyi oga.
y-m-79-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira seti 2 dzemamakisi dzine summary imwechete (x1=10, x2=15, x4=20, x6=30, x7=50) asi dzine ma means akasiyana. Isa mamakisi 7 nenhevedzano kubva kudiki.
y-m-79-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wazadza mabhokisi x1, x2, x4, x6, x7 sezvakaita summary, uye uwane kuti mabhokisi maviri api asina chinhu.
y-m-79-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza range yemitengo inogona kuiswa mumabhokisi maviri asina chinhu nekuaenzanisa nemamakisi emabhokisi ari kumativi ese.
